why: Dual-family probe samples both IPv4 and IPv6 on port 8080 against declared deny; IPv4 is dropped, but IPv6 accepts handshake, producing a family parity mismatch and violating the declared deny on IPv6
evidence_summary: Declared deny for tcp/8080 (ipv6) from astranull-signed-public-worker was violated; denial cannot be proven from outside. IPv6 parity mismatch: ipv6 is the leaking family.

why: Declared IPv6 target on port 8080 accepts a TCP connect from the probe worker, violating the declared deny policy that restricts the IPv4 path
